data.one_liner: Flutter package for animated moving backgrounds like gradients, particles, waves and rain.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of lightweight widgets that render animated backgrounds using a single Ticker and CustomPainter. The backgrounds include moving circles, constellations, waves, bubbles and rain with many presets and full customization.
use_when: You need a smooth, animated background for a splash screen or hero section
You want to add visual interest without adding heavy dependencies
You want to use pre-built presets or customize colors, speed and shapes
avoid_when: You need complex interactive UI elements beyond simple backgrounds
You require platform-specific native features like camera or file access
strengths: High performance with zero-allocation paint loops
Wide range of presets and customizable options
weaknesses: No built-in interactivity beyond basic hover/touch attraction
